item.title: Omar criticizes Trump's 'hateful rhetoric' after attack; suspect had made pro-Trump posts online
item.description: The man accused of squirting an unknown substance on Democratic U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar at a town hall in Minneapolis has a criminal history and made online posts supportive of President Donald Trump.

item.title: Partial shutdown seems increasingly likely as Democrats demand ICE changes
item.description: A partial government shutdown is looming at week’s end. And now Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer has laid out a list of demands for the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Ice fishing dangers: Why Kentucky's frozen ponds aren't safe for winter activities
item.description: Winter weather in Kentucky may make ice fishing and skating on local ponds look tempting, but first responders are warning residents to stay off the ice at all costs.
